content_of_post_to_comment: No, you cannot walk 10,000 steps daily, get 8 hours of sleep, cook every night, clean every day, take care of a family, make time for your own hobbies, and still be productive at work every day. This is not just propaganda, it is nonsense. Free yourself from it.
comment: The hidden cost of these “ideal routines” is that they turn care into another performance metric. Maybe the real shift is not doing everything daily, but designing a life where neglected things rotate without becoming failures.
